headline: Viceroy Hotels approves terms of rights issue
sum: Viceroy Hotels Limited's rights issue committee has approved the terms of a planned rights offering, disclosed to NSE on 14 August 2026 under material disclosure norms.
implication: The approval of rights issue terms is a key gating event under SEBI (ICDR) Regulations 2018 — subsequent approval by the board and shareholders (in general meeting) will be required before the issue can proceed; timing and pricing will be material for existing shareholders' dilution analysis.
detail: Viceroy Hotels Limited, a hospitality and luxury property operator, has formally notified the stock exchange of the rights issue committee's approval of the issue terms. This disclosure triggers mandatory obligations under the Listing Regulations to provide full details (issue size, offer ratio, pricing) to shareholders and the exchange within prescribed timelines. The company is likely to hold a shareholder meeting within 30 days for final approval, following which the rights prospectus will be filed with SEBI.
